must_fail_truncated.pdf.notes: Valid PDF-1.4 header truncated mid-stream. PASS only when the converter itself refuses it: DocumentConverter::convert returns Err (stage converter_error) or Ok with ConversionStatus::Failure (stage converter_status). A SourceDocument::from_file error (stage source) is FAIL: the fixture never reached the converter. Success or PartialSuccess is FAIL with the finding "converter accepts truncated PDF". The fixture is never altered to force a pass. The receipt also states what kind of refusal it was (refusal_kind), computed from the error text.
